name: Unfurl web UI (dfir.blog / hindsig.ht)
operator: Ryan Benson (obsidianforensics, author of the open-source Unfurl project)
tier_rationale: Open-source DFIR tool (Apache-2.0) with an identifiable author and public documentation since 2019 (A8 community).

reliability.justification: URL-structure decoding tool; results are parse output, not threat intelligence.

unfurl_web.title: Unfurl web UI (manual pivot link only; https://dfir.blog/unfurl/ now redirects to https://hindsig.ht/unfurl/)

terms.quote: No automated call to dfir.blog or any Unfurl service (manual link only). Unfurl code is ported only after re-checking its Apache-2.0 LICENSE, with attribution.

unfurl_web.notes: Quote: binding council text (P064 cond 2). V3LUM never requests these hosts: the url_unwrap pivot pack renders a manual link (the web UI sends the URL to the author's cloud function when opened, so it is non-clickable at TLP:AMBER and above). No Unfurl code is ported.

notes: Owned by batch p1-G03-1 (P064 url_unwrap). Link host only.
